provenance.author: Farrokh Labib
provenance.method: projection monotonicity applied to the exact rank-5 exclusion at m = 7

compute.hardware: Apple silicon laptop, one to three cores

llm.role: wrote and ran the exact certificate, its controls and cross-checks

notes: With bounds/cat-m8-upper-6.json, chi(cat_8) = 6; improves bounds/cat-m8-lower-5.json. (<0|_1 (x) I)|cat_8> = 2^(-1/2)|cat_7> is checked symbolically against target_vector in the run, and <0| maps a stabilizer state to a stabilizer state or 0, so chi(cat_8) >= chi(cat_7) >= 6 by the exact exclusion described in bounds/cat-m7-lower-6.json. The compute is that of the m = 7 search; nothing beyond it was run for m = 8.
